best_for: Windows 10 and 11 or recent Mac users who want a paid VPN that covers up to ten devices at once, and who can live with a subscription.

points.title: Paid only, with a 30-day refund
points.text: There is no free tier. A new subscription bought from NordVPN can be refunded within 30 days of the first payment, but renewals are not refundable unless local law says so. Purchases made through Apple, Amazon or a reseller are refunded by that store, not by NordVPN.

points.title: Ten devices at the same time
points.text: One account can stay signed in on any number of devices, but only ten can be connected at once. On a single server, at most five of them can connect, each using a different protocol. A router running NordVPN takes one slot and covers every device behind it.

points.title: More than a tunnel
points.text: The Windows app adds real-time protection that blocks ads, trackers, phishing sites and malware, an internet kill switch, and a choice of NordLynx, NordWhisper or OpenVPN. Double VPN servers are in the same server list.

points.title: Old Windows gets a frozen app
points.text: The current app needs 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11. Windows 7, 8.1 and 32-bit Windows 10 can only use a legacy app that no longer gets updates. The installer here is x64 and installs for all users, so it needs administrator rights.

points.title: On a Mac, the website build does more
points.text: Both Mac versions need macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The direct download listed here (a universal .pkg) has full real-time protection, a per-app kill switch and custom DNS. The App Store version runs inside Apple's sandbox with limited real-time protection, but adds VPN bypass prevention and App Store updates.

points.title: One user per computer
points.text: The VPN protects the whole device, not one login. On a PC shared by several user accounts, only one of them can use the NordVPN app at a time.

points.title: Downgrades on Windows only
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 51 versions. macOS lists only the current release, so an older Mac build has to come from another source.
